one_liner: Senior NGA contracting officer-track role: plan, negotiate, award, and administer complex DoD contracts under the FAR, on-site in Springfield with TS/SCI.
fit_summary: This full-performance contracting job requires leading source selections, cost and price analysis, negotiations and administering FFP, T&M, cost-reimbursement and IDIQ contracts, plus mentoring junior staff. Daniel's proposal and purchasing work at IEM was contractor-side, so he won't meet the mandatory criteria.
eligibility: Open to the public (U.S. citizens); no federal status required, and Daniel's lack of veterans' preference is not disqualifying.

Must meet ALL Mandatory Qualification Criteria with specific examples and results: acquisition strategy/market research, leading source selections or major sole-source buys, FAR knowledge, multiple contract types, complex contract administration, and mentoring junior contract professionals.
A bachelor's degree is mandatory. His M.A. (George Mason, 2016) implies one.
Must be able to obtain and keep a TS/SCI clearance, pass a counterintelligence polygraph and drug test, and file an annual SF-714 financial disclosure.
Must obtain DAWIA Contracting certification within 36 months, then complete 80 continuous learning hours every two years.
strategy: Skip this one: his resume shows proposal writing but not pricing, task-order management or contract modifications.

If contracting interests him, target entry-level GS-1102 contract specialist roles at GS-7/9 that are open to the public; otherwise, FEMA, Virginia VDEM or Prince William County emergency management and policy roles are a better near-term path.
resume_bullets: Found multimillion-dollar opportunities in SAM.gov, GovWin, BidPro and the DHS acquisition forecast, and led proposal writing (2019–2024).
Procured supplies and set up vendor relationships for COVID-19 sites in six states (2021–2022).
interview_questions: Walk us through a source selection or sole-source procurement you led, including how you did the price analysis and negotiation.
How do you decide which contract type (FFP, T&M, cost-reimbursement, IDIQ) fits a customer requirement?
Describe a high-impact problem on a contract you administered and how you resolved it with the COR and contractor.
How have you coached or mentored junior contracting staff?
watch_outs: Senior-level mandatory criteria assume years of direct federal contracting experience Daniel does not appear to have.
TS/SCI with polygraph, annual financial disclosure, fully on-site work in Springfield (no telework), and a recruitment-incentive service agreement with repayment risk.
Open-continuous pool: there is no immediate opening, and applications are reviewed only when needs arise, so expect long or no response.
